neighbours.label: the conjunction right after 'goods' or 'products' that sets up 'services' (goods and | services), as against 'and/or' joining other commercial or everyday nouns
fire: Inflation pushed up the price of most goods and services in the region.
The trade deal removes tariffs on goods and services between the two countries.
Small firms that export goods and services can apply for the grant.
The store accepts the voucher for selected goods and services only.
Consumers spent less on imported goods and services last year.
The platform lets you sell digital products or services to a global audience.
The census asked which goods and services households bought most often.
Local markets offer a mix of handmade goods and services from nearby villages.
quiet: Inflation pushed up the price of rent and fuel in the region.
The trade deal removes tariffs on steel and aluminium between the two countries.
Small firms that hire apprentices and interns can apply for the grant.
The store accepts the voucher for selected shoes and bags only.
Consumers spent less on travel and dining last year.
The platform lets you share photos and videos with a global audience.
The census asked which languages and dialects households spoke most often.
Local markets offer a mix of fresh fruit and vegetables from nearby villages.

predictions: fire 0.5-0.95 on ' and'/' or' after goods/products; 'and' after other nouns below 0.05
notes: Card: ' and' in 'Goods and Services Tax' 298, 'goods, services' 296, 'products or services' 268; the - pole promotes ' services'.
